typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		AppId as string,
		AppName as string,
		CloudAppId as string,
		ContainerId as string,
		Foundation as string,
		Org as string,
		Space as string,
		Type as string,
		DepEnv as string,
		DiegoIp as string,
		Instance as string,
		MemoryPercentage as string,
		{TotalMemory(GB)} as string,
		{UsedMemory(GB)} as string,
		DiskPercentage as string,
		{TotalDisk(GB)} as string,
		{UsedDisk(GB)} as string,
		CpuPercentage as string,
		Lob as string,
		{Technical Manager} as string,
		{Leadership Level1} as string,
		{Leadership Level2} as string,
		{Leadership Level3} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Space as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Org as string,
		Instance as string,
		CloudAppId as string,
		TotalMemory_GB_ as string,
		CpuPercentage as string,
		TotalDisk_GB_ as string,
		AppName as string,
		Type as string,
		DepEnv as string,
		Leadership_Level3 as string,
		Leadership_Level2 as string,
		AppId as string,
		ContainerId as string,
		Technical_Manager as string,
		MemoryPercentage as string,
		Foundation as string,
		DiegoIp as string,
		DiskPercentage as string,
		Leadership_Level1 as string,
		Lob as string,
		UsedMemory_GB_ as string,
		UsedDisk_GB_ as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Space,
		ImportDate,
		Org,
		Instance,
		CloudAppId,
		TotalMemory_GB_ = {TotalMemory(GB)},
		CpuPercentage,
		TotalDisk_GB_ = {TotalDisk(GB)},
		AppName,
		Type,
		DepEnv,
		Leadership_Level3 = {Leadership Level3},
		Leadership_Level2 = {Leadership Level2},
		AppId,
		ContainerId,
		Technical_Manager = {Technical Manager},
		MemoryPercentage,
		Foundation,
		DiegoIp,
		DiskPercentage,
		Leadership_Level1 = {Leadership Level1},
		Lob,
		UsedMemory_GB_ = {UsedMemory(GB)},
		UsedDisk_GB_ = {UsedDisk(GB)}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
